description: Validates EDPS methodology compliance across project artifacts

checks.remediation: Run edps-compliance on the process hierarchy

checks.description: No error-severity compliance rule may have failed
checks.remediation: Fix each failed ERROR rule listed in rule_results, then re-run edps-compliance

checks.description: The overall status must be COMPLIANT or MOSTLY_COMPLIANT
checks.remediation: Resolve violations; a BLOCKED status means hierarchy-validation must pass first

checks.description: The report must carry per-rule results
checks.remediation: Write rule_results with one entry per rule checked

checks.description: The compliance score (0-100) should be at least 80
checks.remediation: Address the remaining warnings to raise the score
